launches.title: Aktoria Robotics is the teleoperation layer to speed up robot deployments
launches.tagline: A 24-hour global network of trained operators, powered by our low-latency teleop software.
launches.body:
**Aktoria Robotics is the teleoperation layer that speeds up robot deployments.**

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UQchwD0U_FFdP9X3FDKJ7UjqXRW_zh24](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UQchwD0U_FFdP9X3FDKJ7UjqXRW_zh24/view?usp=sharing)

Every "autonomous" robot you've seen this year had a human behind it. Full autonomy isn't here yet, and building an in-house teleop team is slow and expensive. That's the bottleneck standing between a working robot and a real deployment.

Aktoria Robotics is a 24-hour global network of trained robot operators across India, Mexico, and the USA, powered by our low-latency teleop software (40ms cross-country) at at least 50% less than the cost of in-house operators. Robotics companies plug in and ship deployments faster.

**The team:** We're Jaskaran Singh Walia and Shreenabh Agrawal, ML and Robotics grad students at CMU. Shreenabh (ex-Zoox) has first-author papers at top robotics conferences. Jaskaran has authored 15+ papers and researched at MIT, Cambridge, and Microsoft Research.

**Our ask:** If you're deploying robots and need reliable teleop, book a call through aktoria.com. Intros to robotics teams requiring teleop are hugely helpful, reply here or reach us at [founders@aktoria.com](mailto:founders@aktoria.com).
